analysis.pricePatternEn: Forming a Lower High, a sign of weakness
analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일 -3.9% 하락으로 하락추세 강화. RSI 59.2에서 48.9로 하락하며 약세 전환. MACD 히스토그램도 0.2210에서 0.0488로 악화되며 매도 압력 증가. 5일 고가 $72.28 대비 현재가 $70.46은 Lower High 패턴 형성. 20일 저가 $68.64 대비 5일 저가 $69.93은 Higher Low 패턴 미형성. ADX 9.3으로 추세 미형성 구간. 시장 전체 QQQ -2.1% 급락과 정합.
analysis.reasonEn: The recent 5-day -3.9% decline reinforces the downtrend. RSI fell from 59.2 to 48.9, turning bearish. MACD histogram also worsened from 0.2210 to 0.0488, increasing selling pressure. The current price of $70.46 against the 5-day high of $72.28 forms a Lower High pattern. The 5-day low of $69.93 did not form a Higher Low against the 20-day low of $68.64. ADX at 9.3 indicates a non-trending phase. Aligns with the overall market QQQ's -2.1% drop.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉은 강세 정렬이나 일봉 신호 우선
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly chart shows bullish alignment, but daily signals take precedence.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.2210→0.0488): 개선세 둔화, 약세 수렴 진입
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $70.78): 중단 부근 횡보 구간
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($69.48): 피벗 S1($68.48) 및 20일 저가($68.64) 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($71.84): 5일 고가($72.28) 및 볼린저 상단($72.84) 기반
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Lower High 형성, Higher Low 미형성): 약화 신호
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.03배): 움직임의 정상 수준 신뢰도
· 현 구간 진단 (하락추세): 매도 진입 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($70.46) vs SMA5/20/50 ($71.59/$70.78/$70.47): Below short/mid-term trend lines.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($68.76/$63.66): Maintaining strength above long-term trend lines.
· 52-week position (90.3%) + Approaching historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.2→48.9): Exited oversold, now in neutral zone, turning bearish.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.2210→0.0488): Slowing improvement, entering bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $70.78): Trading around the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($69.48): Based on Pivot S1 ($68.48) and 20-day low ($68.64).
· Swing resistance ($71.84): Based on 5-day high ($72.28) and Bollinger upper band ($72.84).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High formed, Higher Low not formed): Sign of weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.03x): Normal volume supporting the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Sell entry conditions met.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가 대비 현재가 하락으로 Lower High 패턴 형성, 하락 추세 지속 가능성 시사.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Lower High pattern formed as current price declined from the 5-day high, suggesting potential continuation of the downtrend.
keyPoints: MACD 히스토그램 0.2210 → 0.0488 악화, 매도 압력 증가

MACD histogram worsening from 0.2210 to 0.0488 increases selling pressure.

analysis.riskNote: ADX 9.3으로 추세 미형성 구간, 급락은 추세적 붕괴가 아닌 충격성 변동 가능성 내포.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 9.3 indicates a non-trending phase; sharp declines may represent shock-driven volatility rather than a structural breakdown.

analysis.continuityEn: After holding a wait-and-see stance for the past 2 sessions, today's RSI decline and MACD histogram worsening triggered a shift to a sell action.
